section: Individual Satyagraha, August Offer, Cripps Mission

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Person)
a. Tanguturi Prakasam
b. Pattabhi Sitaramayya
c. Suryadevara Annapurnamma
d. Chilukuri Sattireddy

List-II (Place)
i. Tiruvuru
ii. Madras
iii. Nandigama
iv. Bandar
o: a–ii, b–iv, c–iii, d–i
a–iv, b–ii, c–i, d–iii
a–ii, b–iii, c–iv, d–i
a–iii, b–iv, c–ii, d–i
accepted.x: Tanguturi Prakasam was associated with Madras, Pattabhi Sitaramayya with Bandar, Suryadevara Annapurnamma with Nandigama and Chilukuri Sattireddy with Tiruvuru.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure person–place pair and eliminate codes containing a swapped location.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the organisation of the State Congress in Andhra during Individual Satyagraha:
1. Kala Venkat Rao was the chief secretary of the APCC.
2. Kala Venkat Rao named Mantena Venkata Raju as the ‘Dictator’ of the State Congress.
3. Mantena Venkata Raju named Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri.
4. Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri was also arrested.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1, 2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 4 only
2, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Kala Venkat Rao named Mantena Venkata Raju the State Congress ‘Dictator’, and Mantena in turn named Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri, who was arrested.
accepted.tq: Trace the sequence of authority and appointments carefully instead of treating the names as interchangeable.

accepted.s: During Individual Satyagraha in Andhra, which of the following groups offered satyagraha in their constituencies and were arrested?
o: Suryadevara Annapurnamma, Chilukuri Sattireddy and the Ongole Municipality
Tanguturi Prakasam, Pattabhi Sitaramayya and several MPs and MLAs
Kala Venkat Rao, Mantena Venkata Raju and Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri only
Vinoba Bhave, Jawaharlal Nehru and Vallabhbhai Patel only
accepted.x: Tanguturi Prakasam, Pattabhi Sitaramayya and several Members of Parliament and Members of Legislative Assemblies offered satyagraha in their constituencies and were arrested.
accepted.tq: Identify the persons linked with the specific action rather than with the later protest against arrests.

accepted.s: Which of the following Andhra individual satyagrahis had their properties attached for failure to pay the fines imposed on them?
o: Kala Venkat Rao and Tanguturi Prakasam
Suryadevara Annapurnamma and Chilukuri Sattireddy
Tanguturi Prakasam and Pattabhi Sitaramayya
Mantena Venkata Raju and Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri
accepted.x: Suryadevara Annapurnamma of Nandigama and Chilukuri Sattireddy of Tiruvuru were arrested, and their properties were attached for unpaid fines.
accepted.tq: Separate the arrest-and-property-attachment episode from the broader list of arrested satyagrahis.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Suryadevara Annapurnamma — Nandigama
Chilukuri Sattireddy — Tiruvuru
Pattabhi Sitaramayya — Ongole Municipality
Ongole Municipality — condemned the arrests of Vinoba Bhave, Jawaharlal Nehru and Vallabhbhai Patel
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya was associated with Bandar in this context. The Ongole Municipality condemned the arrests of Vinoba Bhave, Jawaharlal Nehru and Vallabhbhai Patel.
accepted.tq: Find the one mismatched person–place or institution–action pair.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly expresses the distinctive significance of the August Offer and the Cripps Mission?
o: The August Offer created the provincial opt-out principle, whereas the Cripps Mission introduced separate electorates.
The August Offer first conceded provincial opt-out, whereas the Cripps Mission first accepted a post-war constitution-making body.
The August Offer first accepted a post-war constitution-making body, whereas the Cripps Mission first conceded the provincial option to opt out.
Both the August Offer and the Cripps Mission rejected the idea of a post-war constitution-making body.
accepted.x: The August Offer marked the first acceptance of a post-war constitution-making body. The Cripps Mission first conceded the possibility of provincial opt-out, regarded as the germ of Partition.
accepted.tq: Compare the two proposals by assigning each distinctive concession to the correct one.

accepted.s: The provincial opt-out conceded by the Cripps Mission was regarded as the germ of which later development?
o: The establishment of the Constituent Assembly
The formation of linguistic states
The integration of princely states
The Partition of India
accepted.x: The Cripps Mission’s concession that provinces could opt out of the proposed union was regarded as the germ of the Partition of India.
accepted.tq: Connect the constitutional concession with its stated historical consequence.

accepted.s: During the Cripps Mission, which combination of circumstances led Mahatma Gandhi to use the phrase ‘Quit India’ in Harijan?
o: The arrest of Andhra satyagrahis in Madras and Bandar; the phrase appeared in Harijan in August 1942.
The bombing of Pearl Harbor; the phrase appeared in Harijan in March 1940.
Rumours of Japanese bombing of Vizag and Kakinada; the phrase appeared in Harijan in April 1942.
The rejection of the August Offer by the Congress; the phrase appeared in Harijan in December 1941.
accepted.x: Rumours of Japanese bombing of Vizag and Kakinada during the Cripps Mission led Gandhi to use the phrase ‘Quit India’ in Harijan in April 1942.
accepted.tq: Link the event, geographical locations and publication date instead of relying on the familiar Quit India year alone.
